en.why: Camera distance and focal length move in opposite directions, so the subject keeps its size while only the perspective behind it stretches or flattens. The viewer sees the space deform without finding where the camera moved. The shot starts wide, with the hall converging on a vanishing point and small windows on its sides, and ends long, with the hall pressed flat and one wall filling the frame, so the change itself is the reveal. The foreground chips sit nearer to the camera than the phone, so they shrink as the camera backs away while the background grows, which shows which layer is moving.
spec: Timing

Film 10.5s. 0–0.9s fade in from black; 0–1.0s slow creep back (distance 905→950px); 0.1–0.95s the hall rings light up from far to near (0.5s each, 0.05s apart) and the light strips fade in over 0.1–1.0s; 1.0–5.8s dolly zoom (4.8s, 144 frames); 5.8–10.5s slow residual drift (distance 7000→9800px); 0.1–1.3s phone rises; 0.5–1.8s the six floating windows are revealed top-down with expo.out (0.8s each, 0.1s apart, fully opaque); 0.5–1.7s the phone's hero number counts 47,602→48,213 and the line chart draws over 0.5–1.8s; the two chips pop in at 0.9s and 1.1s (0.6s each, back.out(1.6)); 1.6–2.7s the six windows slide out to the sides in turn while fading (each slides 450px over 0.6s and fades over 0.4s starting at the same moment: the four far ones from 1.6s, 0.15s apart; the two nearest, at z=−300 and z=−600, from 2.2s and 2.3s), and no window is left on the wall from 2.7s; 2.1–2.7s the two chips fade; 5.0s a new signup lands on the phone and on the web dashboard in the same frame; 6.2–7.6s wall darkens and phone moves right, 6.7–8.0s mark, wordmark, tagline and URL enter; hold to 10.5s
Easing

Distance is eased in log space with cubic-bezier(0.55,0.05,0.5,1): distance = 950 × (7000/950)^e, about 1,100px at 2.0s, 1,800px at 3.0s, 4,000px at 4.0s and 6,400px at 5.0s, so the wall is still growing between 3.8s and 5.8s; residual drift 7000→9800px with power1.out; phone tilt −16°→−9° with cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0.1,1) over 1.3–5.8s (4.5s), then →−4° with power1.out over 5.8–10.5s; window slide-out power2.in 0.6s with a 0.4s power2.out fade; window reveal, lockup entrance and the phone's move right (1.3s) use expo.out
Camera

CSS 3D, perspective grows from 950px to 7000px, which narrows the vertical field of view from about 59° to about 9° (7.4x). The subject plane at z=0 is unaffected by perspective and stays 1:1. The end-wall dashboard at z=−2800 is 2650px wide in the world (1866×1.42) and grows on screen from 671px to 1893px (2.8x), and the residual drift takes it to 2061px at 10.5s. Foreground chips at z=+170 scale from about 1.22 at 1.0s to about 1.18 at 2.1s, when they start to fade
Subject

Phone 410×864px (screen 390×844, 54px corner radius), about 16px thick, built from 8 slices, tilt rotateY −30°→−16° (0.1–1.3s, expo.out). Hall 2760×1552 in cross-section and 2800px long, four 6px accent light strips, 9 hairline rings every 280px (white at 20%), grid lines on floor, ceiling and side walls at 7.5–12% white. Six 520px-wide windows whose content is not repeated on the end wall: checkout funnel, alert rules, experiments, error rate, top events, traffic sources, at z=−300 to −2400. The web dashboard is 1866×1050, scaled 1.42x onto the end wall. The two chips sit in empty space: the online count outside the phone's top-right corner, Signups +6.1% at the lower left
Sync

At 5.0s the phone's Live now list and the web dashboard's Live events both insert a Priya Nair signup_completed row, both Signups values change from 8,412 to 8,413 and online users go 2,418→2,419; both chips have faded by 2.7s, and the +6.1% on the Signups chip matches the KPI on the phone and the web dashboard; the lockup enters after the phone has moved right (from 6.7s)
Style

Dark, background #09090b, one accent #c9f24b; UI in Inter: dashboard text 11–14.5px with a 19px page title and 28–30px values; window text 11–15px (windows scaled 1.18x) with 24–34px values; phone text 10.5–16.5px with 21px KPI values, a 32px Overview title and a 42px hero number; wordmark Vantage 156px, tagline 40px, URL button 28px; vignette to 55% black, wall dimming from 22% to 65% plus a scrim behind the lockup that is about 97% black on the left and 50% black on the right
en.prompt: Build a product reveal called Dolly Zoom Reveal as a 10.5-second dark film (#09090b, accent #c9f24b). Use a CSS 3D world whose stage perspective is driven by a variable and whose subject plane is z=0. The subject is a phone (410×864px, screen 390×844) rebuilt in DOM/SVG as the Vantage mobile Overview screen: Active users 48,213, a 7-day line chart, four KPI cards, a Live now list and a tab bar. It rises from tilt rotateY −30° to −16° over 0.1–1.3s with expo.out; its hero number counts from 47,602 to 48,213 over 0.5–1.7s and the line chart draws over 0.5–1.8s. The background is a hall 2760×1552 in cross-section and 2800px long with four 6px accent light strips (fading in over 0.1–1.0s), 9 hairline rings every 280px (white at 20%, lighting from far to near over 0.1–0.95s, 0.5s each, 0.05s apart), grid lines on the floor, ceiling and side walls (7.5–12% white), six 520px-wide dashboard windows whose content is not repeated on the end wall (checkout funnel, alert rules, experiments, error rate, top events, traffic sources; z from −300 to −2400, each turned 10–14° toward the center), and at the far end (z=−2800) a wall holding the Vantage web dashboard (1866×1050, scaled 1.42x, 2650px wide in the world). Two foreground chips sit at z=+170 in empty space: '2,418 online now' outside the phone's top-right corner and 'Signups +6.1%' at the lower left, with values that match the KPIs in the UI; they pop in at 0.9s and 1.1s with back.out(1.6), 0.6s each. The picture fades in from black over 0–0.9s. Camera: 0–1.0s creep back from distance 905 to 950px; 1.0–5.8s dolly zoom with perspective distance 950→7000px, eased in log space with cubic-bezier(0.55,0.05,0.5,1) (distance = 950 × (7000/950)^e, about 1,100px at 2.0s, 1,800px at 3.0s, 4,000px at 4.0s and 6,400px at 5.0s, so the wall keeps growing between 3.8s and 5.8s), which narrows the vertical field of view from about 59° to about 9° while the phone keeps its size, the hall opens out and flattens, the dashboard on the end wall grows from 671px to 1893px wide to fill the frame, the chips shrink and fade out between 2.1 and 2.7s, and the tilt eases −16°→−9° with cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0.1,1) over 4.5s. The six windows are revealed top-down between 0.5 and 1.8s without transparency, in the order checkout funnel, experiments, alert rules, error rate, traffic sources, top events (expo.out, 0.8s each, 0.1s apart, a clip-path opening from the top edge with a 36px rise). They then slide out 450px to the sides in turn (power2.in, 0.6s) and fade over 0.4s (power2.out) starting at the same moment: the four far ones from 1.6s, 0.15s apart, the two nearest (z=−300 and z=−600) from 2.2s and 2.3s. All windows are gone from 2.7s, so none covers the wall once it is readable. From 5.8 to 10.5s the distance drifts 7000→9800px with power1.out and the tilt goes −9°→−4°. At 5.0s a new signup row (Priya Nair, signup_completed) appears on the phone and on the web dashboard in the same frame, and Signups changes from 8,412 to 8,413 and online users from 2,418 to 2,419. From 6.2 to 7.6s the wall dims to 65% with a scrim of about 97% black on the left and 50% black on the right, the phone moves 470px right with expo.out (1.3s), and the lockup (mark, Vantage 156px, the 40px tagline 'Live product analytics on every screen.', and the 28px button 'vantage.app') enters on the left between 6.7 and 8.0s with expo.out and holds to 10.5s. Use no Date.now or Math.random.
says: The phone keeps its size while the hall behind it stretches and flattens
The camera backs away but the frame seems to push in
The background goes from a deep hall to one wall of dashboard
vs: Macro Pull-out Reveal pulls the camera back so the subject shrinks; in Dolly Zoom Reveal the phone keeps its size and only the perspective of the background changes.
Device Push-in Focus moves the camera toward parts of a device; Dolly Zoom Reveal picks no part and changes the depth of the whole space.

zh.why: 主体到镜头的距离和焦距反向变化，主体大小不变，只有背景的透视被拉伸或压平，观众看到空间在变形，却找不到镜头在哪里动；起点是广角、走廊向消失点收拢、侧面的窗口很小，终点是长焦、走廊压成平面、背景一面墙占满画面，这个变化本身就是揭示；前景的提示气泡在 z 轴上更靠近镜头，会随镜头后退反而缩小，和背景变大形成反向，让观众看清是哪一层在动。
spec: 时长

全片 10.5s。0–0.9s 画面从黑淡入；0–1.0s 镜头缓慢后退（视距 905→950px）；0.1–0.95s 走廊的细环由远及近亮起（每道 0.5s，间隔 0.05s），光带 0.1–1.0s 淡入；1.0–5.8s 滑动变焦（4.8s，144 帧）；5.8–10.5s 缓慢余漂（视距 7000→9800px）；0.1–1.3s 手机升起；0.5–1.8s 六个浮窗用 expo.out 从上往下依次显出（每个 0.8s，间隔 0.1s，不透明）；0.5–1.7s 手机大数字 47,602→48,213 计数，折线 0.5–1.8s 画出；0.9s 和 1.1s 两个气泡各用 0.6s 弹出（back.out(1.6)）；1.6–2.7s 六个浮窗依次向两侧滑出并淡出（每个滑 450px 用 0.6s，同一时刻起淡出 0.4s：远处四个从 1.6s 起，间隔 0.15s；最近的两个 z=−300 和 z=−600 从 2.2s 和 2.3s 起），2.7s 起墙面上没有浮窗；2.1–2.7s 两个气泡淡出；5.0s 手机和网页端同帧出现一条新注册；6.2–7.6s 墙面压暗、手机右移，6.7–8.0s 字标、标语、网址依次入场；停到 10.5s
缓动

视距在对数空间里按 cubic-bezier(0.55,0.05,0.5,1) 变化：视距 = 950 × (7000/950)^e，约 2.0s 到 1,100px、3.0s 到 1,800px、4.0s 到 4,000px、5.0s 到 6,400px，所以 3.8–5.8s 墙面仍在变大；余漂 7000→9800px，power1.out；手机倾角 −16°→−9° 用 cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0.1,1)，1.3–5.8s 共 4.5s，再用 power1.out 在 5.8–10.5s 到 −4°；浮窗滑出 power2.in 0.6s，淡出 power2.out 0.4s；浮窗显出、字标入场、手机右移（1.3s）都用 expo.out
镜头

CSS 3D，perspective 从 950px 加大到 7000px，纵向视场角从约 59° 收到约 9°（7.4 倍）。主体平面 z=0 不受透视影响，大小保持 1:1。背景末端的网页端仪表盘在 z=−2800，世界里宽 2650px（1866×1.42），画面宽度从 671px 长到 1893px（2.8 倍），余漂再把它拉到 10.5s 的 2061px。前景气泡在 z=+170，缩放从 1.0s 的约 1.22 缩到 2.1s 的约 1.18 后开始淡出
主体

手机 410×864px（屏幕 390×844，圆角 54px），约 16px 厚度用 8 层切片做出，倾角 rotateY −30°→−16°（0.1–1.3s，expo.out）。走廊截面 2760×1552、长 2800px，四条 6px 强调色光带，9 道每隔 280px 的细环（白色 20%），地面、天花板、侧墙的网格线为白色 7.5–12%。六个 520px 宽浮窗的内容都不在终点墙上出现：结账漏斗、告警规则、实验、错误率、热门事件、流量来源，位置 z=−300 到 −2400。网页端仪表盘 1866×1050，放大 1.42 倍贴在终点墙上。两个气泡放在空白处：「在线人数」在手机右上角外侧，「Signups +6.1%」在左下角
同步
5.0s 手机的 Live now 列表和网页端的 Live events 同时插入一条 Priya Nair signup_completed，两处 Signups 都从 8,412 变成 8,413，在线人数 2,418→2,419；两个气泡在 2.1–2.7s 已淡出，Signups 气泡的 +6.1% 与手机、网页端的 KPI 一致；字标在手机右移之后（6.7s 起）依次进入
风格

深色，背景 #09090b，只用一个强调色 #c9f24b；界面字体 Inter：网页端正文 11–14.5px、页面标题 19px、数值 28–30px；浮窗正文 11–15px（整体放大 1.18 倍）、数值 24–34px；手机正文 10.5–16.5px、KPI 数值 21px、Overview 标题 32px、大数字 42px；字标 Vantage 156px、标语 40px、网址按钮 28px；暗角到 55% 黑，墙面压暗从 22% 到 65%，字标一侧再叠一层遮罩，左侧约 97% 黑、右侧约 50% 黑
zh.prompt: 用「滑动变焦（Dolly Zoom Reveal）」做一个产品揭示镜头，总长 10.5 秒，深色 #09090b，强调色 #c9f24b。用 CSS 3D 搭一个世界：舞台 perspective 由变量控制，主体平面 z=0。主体是一部手机（410×864px，屏幕 390×844，用 DOM/SVG 重建 Vantage 移动端概览页：活跃用户 48,213、7 天折线、四个指标卡、Live now 列表、标签栏），倾角 rotateY −30°→−16° 在 0.1–1.3 秒用 expo.out 升起；手机大数字在 0.5–1.7 秒从 47,602 计数到 48,213，折线在 0.5–1.8 秒画出。背景是一条走廊：截面 2760×1552、长 2800px，四条 6px 强调色光带（0.1–1.0 秒淡入），9 道每隔 280px 的细环（白色 20%，0.1–0.95 秒由远及近亮起，每道 0.5 秒、间隔 0.05 秒），地面、天花板、侧墙画白色 7.5–12% 的网格线，六个 520px 宽的仪表盘浮窗（内容和终点墙上的卡片不重复：结账漏斗、告警规则、实验、错误率、热门事件、流量来源；z 从 −300 到 −2400，各自带 10–14° 的朝内倾角），走廊终点 z=−2800 贴一面网页端仪表盘墙（1866×1050，放大 1.42 倍，世界里宽 2650px）。前景有两个提示气泡放在 z=+170 的空白处：「2,418 online now」在手机右上角外侧，「Signups +6.1%」在左下角，数值和界面里的 KPI 一致；两个气泡分别在 0.9 秒和 1.1 秒用 back.out(1.6) 弹出，各 0.6 秒。画面 0–0.9 秒从黑淡入。镜头 0–1.0 秒视距 905→950px 缓慢后退，1.0–5.8 秒做滑动变焦：视距 950→7000px，在对数空间按 cubic-bezier(0.55,0.05,0.5,1) 变化（视距 = 950 × (7000/950)^e，约 2.0 秒 1,100px、3.0 秒 1,800px、4.0 秒 4,000px、5.0 秒 6,400px，所以 3.8–5.8 秒墙面还在变大），纵向视场角从约 59° 收到约 9°，手机大小始终不变，走廊向两侧展开并压平，仪表盘从 671px 宽长到 1893px 宽占满画面，气泡缩小并在 2.1–2.7 秒淡出，倾角同时按 cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0.1,1) 用 4.5 秒从 −16° 到 −9°；六个浮窗在 0.5–1.8 秒按结账漏斗、实验、告警规则、错误率、流量来源、热门事件的顺序、用 expo.out 从上往下不透明地显出（每个 0.8 秒、间隔 0.1 秒，用 clip-path 从上沿展开并上移 36px），之后依次向两侧滑出 450px（power2.in，0.6 秒），同时从滑出起点淡出 0.4 秒（power2.out）：远处四个从 1.6 秒起、间隔 0.15 秒，最近的两个（z=−300 和 z=−600）从 2.2 秒和 2.3 秒起；2.7 秒起所有浮窗消失，墙面能读清时没有浮窗压在上面。5.8–10.5 秒视距 7000→9800px 缓慢余漂（power1.out），倾角 −9°→−4°。5.0 秒手机和网页端同帧各插入一条新注册（Priya Nair，signup_completed），Signups 8,412→8,413，在线人数 2,418→2,419。6.2–7.6 秒墙面压暗到 65%、左侧再叠约 97% 黑、右侧约 50% 黑的遮罩，手机用 expo.out 右移 470px（1.3 秒），左侧依次出现字标 Vantage（156px）、标语「Live product analytics on every screen.」（40px）和网址按钮「vantage.app」（28px），6.7–8.0 秒用 expo.out 入场并停到 10.5 秒。全程不使用 Date.now、Math.random 等不确定输入。

en.title: Dolly Zoom Effect: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: The camera backs away as the lens zooms in: a phone holds its size and the hall behind flattens into a dashboard. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: The camera backs away while the lens zooms in, so the phone holds its size in frame, the perspective behind it flattens, and the hall collapses into one wall of dashboard.
en.name: Dolly Zoom Effect

body.h2: How to make a Dolly Zoom Effect with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Put the subject on the z=0 plane of a CSS 3D world and animate only the stage perspective. From 1.0 to 5.8s it grows from 950px to 7000px, eased in log space with cubic-bezier(0.55,0.05,0.5,1), which narrows the vertical field of view from about 59° to about 9°. The phone stays 410×864px while everything behind it changes, and the wall keeps growing until 5.8s instead of settling early.

Build the background as depth cues: a hall 2760×1552 and 2800px long with four 6px light strips and 9 rings every 280px at 20% white, six dashboard windows at z=−300 to −2400, and a web dashboard wall at z=−2800 that is 2650px wide. As the camera backs away the dashboard grows from 671px to 1893px wide, and two chips at z=+170 shrink from about 1.22 at 1.0s to about 1.18 at 2.1s, when they start to fade. Slide the windows out between 1.6 and 2.7s, each fading over 0.4s as it slides 450px, with the two nearest starting at 2.2s and 2.3s, so the wall behind the phone is clear before it becomes readable.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the world, the phone screen and the dashboard from your product. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: A phone analytics app floating in a dark tunnel of grid lines, with dashboard panels stretched along the walls.
faq: What is the dolly zoom effect?

It is a camera move where the camera travels away from the subject while the lens zooms in by the same amount. The subject keeps its size in frame, and the perspective of the background stretches or flattens. It is also called the Vertigo effect.
How do you make a dolly zoom in HTML and CSS?

Place the subject at z=0 inside a preserve-3d world and give objects behind it negative z values. Then animate the perspective distance on the stage. Objects at z=0 do not change size, while objects behind them grow as the distance increases.

zh.description: 镜头后退的同时焦距拉长，手机大小不变，背后的走廊压平成一面仪表盘墙。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个滑动变焦效果。

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做希区柯克变焦效果
body.body:
把主体放在 CSS 3D 世界的 z=0 平面上，只对舞台的透视距离做动画。1.0 到 5.8s 里它从 950px 加大到 7000px，在对数空间按 cubic-bezier(0.55,0.05,0.5,1) 变化，纵向视场角从约 59° 收到约 9°。手机始终是 410×864px，只有它背后的空间在变，墙面一直长到 5.8s，不会提前停住。

背景用纵深线索搭：截面 2760×1552、长 2800px 的走廊，四条 6px 光带和每隔 280px 的 9 道白色 20% 细环，z=−300 到 −2400 的六个仪表盘浮窗，以及 z=−2800、宽 2650px 的网页端仪表盘墙。镜头后退时仪表盘从 671px 宽长到 1893px，z=+170 的两个气泡从约 1.22 缩到 2.1s 的约 1.18 后开始淡出。浮窗在 1.6 到 2.7s 之间向两侧滑出，每个滑 450px 的同时用 0.4s 淡出，最近的两个从 2.2s 和 2.3s 起，手机背后的墙面在能读清之前已经没有浮窗。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会用你的产品做出这个世界、手机界面和仪表盘。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

faq: 镜头远离主体的同时，焦距按同样比例拉长。主体在画面里大小不变，背景的透视被拉伸或压平，也叫滑动变焦或 Vertigo 效果。
怎么用 HTML 和 CSS 做滑动变焦？
把主体放在 preserve-3d 世界里的 z=0，背景物体取负的 z 值，然后对舞台的透视距离做动画。z=0 的物体大小不变，在它后面的物体随距离变大而变大。
